title: Forecast
description: A single time-bounded geopolitical forecast tracked across daily report updates.

id.description: Stable slug — e.g. '2026-05-11-us-iran-memo-by-may-18'. Used in delta narrative citations: → moved F# refers to this id.

question.description: Binary or resolvable question phrased so YES/NO is unambiguous.

owner_category.description: Broad bucket so the board doesn't become 7 forecasts about the same diplomatic track.

horizon_days.description: Days from created_at to horizon_date (cache for sort).

horizon_date.description: ISO date by which the forecast must resolve. After this date status must transition to RESOLVED-* or AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVED.

created_at.description: When forecast was first added to active.json.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. Past this date a forecast cannot stay ACTIVE; must transition to a resolved/OBE state. Typically = horizon_date + 1 day.

p.description: Current probability. Bounded 5-95% to prevent 99%-theater (per Codex hygiene gate).

p_prior.description: Probability from prior_date (last day this forecast was reasoned about). Survives skipped days unlike p_yesterday.

prior_date.description: ISO date when p_prior was set.

delta_reason.description: ≥1 full sentence explaining the move from p_prior to p, OR the string 'No material movement' if p == p_prior. Empty string forbidden.

resolution_criteria.description: What concretely counts as YES vs NO. Must be specific enough that two analysts would agree on outcome.

resolution_source_rule.description: Which kinds of sources are authoritative for resolution (e.g. 'Reuters/AP/AFP confirmation OR explicit US/Iran government statement OR confirmed leak by ≥2 named officials').

ambiguity_rule.description: Pre-declared rule for what counts as AMBIGUOUS vs YES vs NO at resolution time. Closes the fake-binary loophole (e.g. 'A counter-proposal that defers core terms = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO').

observed_at.description: Most recent date this indicator state was confirmed.

source_ids.description: Optional list of source IDs (from today's SOURCES list) that confirm this state.

expected_effect.description: What this indicator's transition to OBSERVED would imply for p (e.g. '+10pp toward YES if observed before horizon_date').

status.description: ACTIVE = open and being reasoned. OPEN-AMBIGUOUS = live but the question may not cleanly binarize at horizon. RESOLVED-* = past horizon and final. OBE = retired before horizon because events overtook the question.

graveyard_reason.description: Required when status is not ACTIVE/OPEN-AMBIGUOUS. Explains why forecast left active board.

merged_into.description: If graveyard_reason == 'merged', the id of the forecast this was merged into.

last_reasoned_at.description: Most recent date the Analyst actively reasoned about this forecast (may differ from prior_date if probability didn't change).
